command:
$root = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.').Path
. (Join-Path $root '.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Common.ps1')
$priorRecordPath = Join-Path $root '.forge-codex\state\commands\20260830T220206441Z-ee70768c.json'
$priorRecord = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $priorRecordPath | ConvertFrom-Json
if ([int]$priorRecord.exit_code -ne 1) { throw 'The antecedent checkpoint record no longer has its expected diagnostic exit code.' }
$priorStdoutPath = Join-Path $root ([string]$priorRecord.stdout)
$priorStderrPath = Join-Path $root ([string]$priorRecord.stderr)
if ((Get-FileSha256 $priorStdoutPath) -cne [string]$priorRecord.stdout_sha256) { throw 'The antecedent checkpoint stdout hash does not match its record.' }
if ((Get-FileSha256 $priorStderrPath) -cne [string]$priorRecord.stderr_sha256) { throw 'The antecedent checkpoint stderr hash does not match its record.' }
$priorStdout = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $priorStdoutPath
$priorStderr = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $priorStderrPath
$requiredMarkers = @(
    '11/11 Windows telemetry tests passed.',
    '100% tests passed out of 7',
    'QUALIFIED_MACHINE_PDH_COMPRESSED_PAGE_COUNT_MATCHES=0',
    'G04_STATIC_PREFIX_PASSED',
    'No-Python gate passed.',
    'No-attribution gate passed.',
    'Ledger validation passed: 520 event(s).'
)
foreach ($marker in $requiredMarkers) {
    if ($priorStdout.IndexOf($marker, [StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0) { throw "Antecedent checkpoint marker is missing: $marker" }
}
if ($priorStderr.IndexOf("The term 'Get-FileHash' is not recognized", [StringComparison]::Ordinal) -lt 0) { throw 'The antecedent diagnostic cause is not the expected post-gate hashing-tool failure.' }
Write-Output 'ANTECEDENT_BUILD_TEST_AND_POLICY_EVIDENCE_VERIFIED'

$artifacts = @(
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Telemetry.WindowsTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Domain.UnitTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Dashboard.TelemetryJsonCodecTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Dashboard.TelemetrySourceTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Dashboard.ConnectionApplicationTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Manager.DoctorServiceTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/bin/Release/ForgeConductor.Contracts.ContractTests.exe',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/lib/Release/ForgeConductor.Telemetry.Windows.lib',
    'out/build/windows-msvc-x64/lib/Release/ForgeConductor.Domain.lib'
)
foreach ($relativePath in $artifacts) {
    $artifactPath = Join-Path $root $relativePath.Replace('/', '\')
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $artifactPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Missing expected artifact: $relativePath" }
    $hash = Get-FileSha256 $artifactPath
    $length = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $artifactPath).Length
    Write-Output "ARTIFACT_SHA256=$hash BYTES=$length PATH=$relativePath"
}

& (Join-Path $root '.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Validate-NoPython.ps1') -WorkspaceRoot $root
& (Join-Path $root '.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Validate-NoAttribution.ps1') -WorkspaceRoot $root
& (Join-Path $root '.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Verify-Ledger.ps1') -WorkspaceRoot $root
& git diff --check
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git diff --check failed.' }
Write-Output 'RAM_CHECKPOINT_CONTINUATION_PASSED'
